title: upgrade-subscription-plan-inapp.html
content: Go to the Messaging Admin tab. In the Current Plan section, click Upgrade Account . Confirm that the Business Name, Business Address, Industry, and Company Website are correct. Click . Confirm that the Business Entity Type, Business Registration Number, Business Registration Number Type, and Company Status are correct. Click . Confirm the following information. Primary Contact: First Name, Last Name, Title, Job Position, Email, Phone Secondary Contact: First Name, Last Name, Title, Job Position, Email, Phone Click . Review all of the information, and if correct, click Submit . Review the available plans and click Select Plan next to your selection. For more information about pricing, click here . Review the plan you selected. Enter any additional User Licenses and/or Phone Numbers you need. Click Confirm and Pay . Enter a Payment Method and related address. Review the policy and terms agreement and click the checkbox. Click Confirm . Congratulations! You have upgraded your plan.
